pagePrompts.prompt: Morning establishing shot of Eastsea Academy in a technologically advanced soul-master city, crowds of new students, cool mist, Lam Mac alone beneath a tree with an old backpack, quiet and observant, large cinematic environment panel.
Lam Mac activates subtle silver Heavenly Eye, POV reveals colored soul-power currents inside students as elegant translucent ribbons, mystical not sci-fi HUD, sensory overload, close eye detail.

Tang Wulin passes through a crowd; Lam Mac notices a tiny deep golden light inside him; sudden partial golden dragon pressure erupts only inside Lam Mac's perception, dramatic black-gold impact, Lam Mac's eye bleeds slightly.
Warm quiet contrast: Tang Wulin sincerely offers a tissue to Lam Mac, natural school courtyard light, understated friendship first meeting, no aura.
Class assignment board and first meeting with Xie Xie; Xie Xie confident and agile; through Heavenly Eye only, two faint light-and-dark dragon currents spiral behind him.

Noisy lowest-ranked academy class falls silent as Wu Changkong enters, long blue hair, white clothes, elegant cold swordsman presence; Lam Mac's perception imagines one blue sword slash across the panel.
Light comedic classroom sequence: Wu Changkong orders Tang Wulin, Xie Xie and Lam Mac to stay after class; Xie Xie glares, Lam Mac remains deadpan; controlled expressions.
Late-afternoon training ground, Wu Changkong outside the triangle formed by Tang Wulin, Xie Xie and Lam Mac, pre-fight tension, long shadows, clean wide composition.
Xie Xie explodes forward with Light Dragon Dagger, diagonal panel energy and speed lines; Tang Wulin pivots and counters with a simple heavy punch; Lam Mac observes from background.

First soul skill Heavenly Eye: Trajectory; silver-cyan perception world, Xie Xie's motion leaves elegant ghost trajectory lines; Lam Mac narrowly slips past the dagger and steps onto Xie Xie's landing point to break balance.
Tang Wulin throws a direct heavy punch; Lam Mac sees a silver predicted path but golden dragon pressure corrupts and shatters the trajectory visualization; huge clean impact sends Lam Mac backward.
Xie Xie appears behind Lam Mac with dagger at neck; Lam Mac triggers a split-second mental shock and sweeps his leg; Tang Wulin is already entering the frame, fast multi-character action continuity.
After the spar: Xie Xie on the ground, Tang Wulin seated catching breath, Lam Mac leaning on the fence; Wu Changkong calmly critiques each student, quiet post-action mood.

Wu Changkong gives a lesson at sunset with strong negative space: seeing an attack does not mean the body can evade it; Lam Mac listens without activating his martial soul; small comedic cooldown with Xie Xie.

Moonlit academy dormitory; Lam Mac secretly looks at sleeping Tang Wulin; vision descends into layers of ancient golden chains and reveals only one enormous dragon eye behind them, dark majestic mystery.
Lam Mac snaps awake with a trace of blood, looks at harmless sleeping Tang Wulin and quietly calls him a monster; final exterior moon over Eastsea Academy, restrained silver glint teaser.
